selection_ceilings.perfect_terminal_sign: negative realized P&L avoided on the fixed 399-cycle ledger
selection_ceilings.false_breakout_avoidance: negative realized P&L avoided for inherited MFE<10% and terminal<=0 cycles
selection_ceilings.severe_loss_avoidance: negative realized P&L avoided for terminal<=-10% cycles
selection_ceilings.warning: ceilings overlap, ignore vacancy/crowding/alternate trades, and are not NAVs

exit_ceilings.mfe_ceiling: sum initial capital * (MFE - terminal return), unclipped
exit_ceilings.peak_close_ceiling: sum initial capital * (peak close return - terminal return), unclipped
exit_ceilings.warning: MFE is an unexecutable intraday-high oracle; peak-close and initial-capital amounts ignore execution, resizing, vacancy, and path feedback

post_exit_path.eligible_sessions: next 1 through 20 authoritative market sessions after exit; exit-day close is excluded
post_exit_path.return_coordinates: corporate-action-adjusted close and high total return from exit execution
post_exit_path.coverage: a horizon is missing unless every intervening symbol-session row is present, hard_valid=true, finite, and every corporate action is visible, valid, non-blocking, and has zero rights ratio
post_exit_path.warning: all post-exit fields are future outcomes; maximum high is an oracle and none is a tradable candidate
